compliant_spring_tpu_95a.structural_purpose: Single-piece print-in-place compliant claw clips (Plate 1). Sliced at 240C in 95A TPU. Enforces a strict 45-degree rotation offset to weave diagonal paths over the central V-groove separation tracks. Replaces brittle 100% solid fills with a 45% sub-surface gyroid matrix loop to scatter hair torsion stress uniformly across a 3D wave web, completely eliminating layer-line delamination fractures while reducing unit mass to 11 grams.

compliant_spring_food_safe_pp.structural_purpose: Alternative high-flex Polypropylene (PP) clip runs (Plate 2). Hardcodes an 8mm outer solid brim and a 45% gyroid core to lower thermal contraction mass, completely defeating plate warping while utilizing rapid G-code fan quenching to secure a permanently flexible, non-brittle amorphous hinge state.
